disposition_reason: Mercury, lead and nickel were measured in marsh clam flesh from two Butuan Bay mangrove sites; mercury and lead were below detection.

study.design: field survey of a wild-harvested food clam with risk assessment
study.origin: mangrove wetlands at Pagatpatan and Masao, Butuan Bay, Agusan del Norte, Philippines
study.market: not sold; gleaned from the wild
study.method: HNO3/H2SO4 acid digestion (AOAC 2012); Hg by cold vapor AAS; Pb and Ni by AAS (commercial laboratory)

findings.notes: live clams gleaned from mangrove wetland, depurated before analysis; number of clams not stated; wet weight implied by risk formulas; below detection limit (CV-AAS)
